decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core range uses existing production with low marginal cost, and with industry turnover growing and no sign of a shortfall against aspirations, there is no trigger for problemistic search to cut it.
Sweet pastries are routine assortment items that fit existing craft skills, and without evidence of underperformance the firm's slack lets it keep them in a medium-range offer.
The crusty farmhouse bread fits the heritage, regional-ingredient positioning and costs little to maintain, so it is likely kept unless sales clearly fall below aspiration.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and is presented as a flagship on its own page, so it exceeds aspirations and anchors the seasonal business, making a drop very unlikely.
The premium stollen also won a gold award, signalling performance above aspiration in the profitable Christmas gift segment, so management will retain it.
